Name: Unicorns (made using Green's redesigned horses as a base)
Author: NightshadowCat93
Description:
Unicorns skin tested on Adopt and Skin mod, based on the "Green's redesigned horses" mod, which is great and I recommend.

To use it just download the zipped file, unzip it, take the png file you want to use, go to the "assets" folder of the Adopt and Skin mod, then go to "skins" and create a folder there named "Horse" and just drop or copy/paste your unicorn skin there and rename it "Horse_1" to replace your horse's skin with the unicorn one.

Should work with other mods but not tested yet.

The mod contains:

- basic bareback white unicorn
- bright white unicorn
- toned down white unicorn
- light blue unicorn
- soft pink unicorn
- glowing unicorn
- phantom unicorn
- dark unicorn

original animation sprites: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17245]green's horses[/url]
compatible with horse saddlebags sprite mod: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8018]saddlebags mod[/url]
